journey.name: ST-01 The first load shows a loading state
journey.description:
Covers FR-07 and NFR-02. REQUIREMENTS.md section 9, precedence 1: with no tasks and a load in flight the screen is Loading and nothing else.
The mock source normally answers in 300-800 ms. A UI dump takes far longer than that - measured on a Samsung SM-G973F, `android layout` needs about 20 s and `uiautomator dump` about 3 s - so the loading state is over before anything can look at it. This journey pins the source to a flat 30 s, which leaves room for either tool. That is the whole reason qa_latency_ms exists; the timing is the test's problem, not the app's.
If you are reading the screen with `adb exec-out uiautomator dump /dev/tty` rather than `android layout`, 8000 is plenty and makes the journey quicker.
This journey asserts only what is on screen *during* the load. That the rows eventually arrive is TL-01's job.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0 --es qa_latency_ms 30000

actions.action: Verify that an element with the content description "Loading" is on screen
Verify that the title "Tasks" is on screen
